use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

coarse(value: ubyte) -> ubyte => cast ubyte(cast int(value) / 16 * 16 + 8)

reduced(image: IMAGE) -> IMAGE is
    let copy = IMAGE(image.width, image.height)

    for y in 0..image.height do
        for x in 0..image.width do
            let p = image.pixel(x, y)

            copy.set_pixel(
                x, y, coarse(p.red), coarse(p.green), coarse(p.blue))
        od
    od

    copy
si

gap(a: ubyte, b: ubyte) -> long =>
    cast long(Math.abs(cast int(a) - cast int(b)))

difference(a: IMAGE, b: IMAGE) -> double is
    assert a.width == b.width /\ a.height == b.height
    else "the images are not the same size"

    let total mut = 0L

    for y in 0..a.height do
        for x in 0..a.width do
            let p = a.pixel(x, y), q = b.pixel(x, y)

            total = total +
                gap(p.red, q.red) + gap(p.green, q.green) +
                gap(p.blue, q.blue)
        od
    od

    let most = 255.0D * 3.0D * cast double(a.width * a.height)

    100.0D * cast double(total) / most
si

let original = scene()

original.write("original.png")
reduced(original).write("reduced.png")

let first = IMAGE.read("original.png")
let second = IMAGE.read("reduced.png")

write_line("original.png against reduced.png, 16 levels a channel")
write_line("difference: {difference(first, second):F5}%")
write_line("original.png against itself: {difference(first, first):F5}%")

first.show("original.png")
second.show("reduced.png")
